en.a: M4 supplied six design axes; M5 turns them into a comparable card without confusing active parameters, cache state, or sequence throughput.
en.b: Every card still describes a prefix-conditioned next-token predictor. The card records how the prefix is represented, mixed, routed, and carried into the next step.

zh.a: M4 提供了六个设计轴；M5 将其转化为可比较的卡片，同时避免混淆活动参数、缓存状态或序列吞吐量。
zh.b: 每张卡片仍然描述一个基于前缀条件的下一个 token 预测器。该卡片记录了前缀如何被表示、混合、路由并带入下一步骤。
